errors.what: Coupler appears too long (about 130 mm instead of 120 mm, roughly 3.2x the crank instead of 3x). Rocker angles do not match the spec geometry: at t=0 the rocker O4->B is about 41 deg from +X, where the spec gives about 63 deg. The measured angles at t=1 and t=3 are also about 10 deg off. The measured values fit a coupler of about 130 mm. A small gap between the coupler end and the rocker end at B is also visible, so the joint does not close exactly.
